title: OmniVia Core Application Contract v1 - stored application settings
description: Provider-neutral wire shapes for the `settings.list` and `settings.set` operation payloads. Both are workspace-scoped through the request envelope and never carry a second, independent workspace identifier. A setting is an opaque, namespaced key and a JSON-encoded value: the contract fixes the envelope, the key grammar (an existing `OpenCode`) and the size bounds, and deliberately fixes neither the key set nor the value shape, because the settings a build offers follow its features and would otherwise require a contract change per feature. `settings.set` identifies its target by key only and is last-writer-wins: it carries no mutation precondition, because a key with no stored row has no version to cite and requiring one would make creating a setting impossible. `record_version` is returned so a caller can see that a value changed under it. Mac-local companion preferences and installation lifecycle configuration are not settings in this sense and are not reachable through these operations. This document declares no root type; it is a definition container only.

SettingValueJson.title: SettingValueJson
SettingValueJson.description: The setting's value, JSON-encoded. A string rather than an open JSON value because a setting may hold a boolean, a number, a string or an object, and the wire type says which only by carrying the encoding. The bound is the stored column's own.

SettingRecord.title: SettingRecord
SettingRecord.description: One stored setting as it currently stands. `record_version` is opaque and round-tripped: a caller that intends to replace this value passes it back as the envelope's `MutationPrecondition.record_version`.

record_version.description: Opaque version of this setting as read. Returned for observability: a caller that re-reads and finds a different version knows another writer has been here.

updated_at.description: When the service last stored this value.

updated_by.description: The component that last stored it, as the service recorded it.

SettingsListInput.title: SettingsListInput
SettingsListInput.description: Input for `settings.list`: every stored setting for the envelope-selected workspace, in key order. `prefix` narrows to one namespace and is matched literally, never as a pattern.

prefix.description: Return only keys beginning with this literal prefix. Omit for every key.

SettingsListResult.title: SettingsListResult
SettingsListResult.description: Result of `settings.list`: the matching settings in key order. An empty list means the workspace has stored none, which is not an error — a setting that has never been written has no row, and the caller applies its own default.

settings.description: The matching settings, in key order.

SettingsSetInput.title: SettingsSetInput
SettingsSetInput.description: Input for `settings.set`: store `value_json` under `key` for the envelope-selected workspace. Identifies its target by key only; it carries no mutation precondition and replaces whatever is stored.

SettingsSetResult.title: SettingsSetResult
SettingsSetResult.description: Result of `settings.set`: the setting as it now stands, including the version a subsequent replacement must carry.
